verses.original: ה֣וֹי רֹעִ֗ים מְאַבְּדִ֧ים וּמְפִצִ֛ים אֶת־ צֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתִ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w rō·‘îm mə·’ab·bə·ḏîm ū·mə·p̄i·ṣîm ’eṯ- ṣōn mar·‘î·ṯî nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of My pasture declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: AI dos pastores que destroem e dispersam as ovelhas do meu pasto, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: לָ֠כֵן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַֽל־ הָרֹעִים֮ הָרֹעִ֣ים אֶת־ עַמִּי֒ אַתֶּ֞ם הֲפִצֹתֶ֤ם אֶת־ צֹאנִי֙ וַתַּדִּח֔וּם וְלֹ֥א פְקַדְתֶּ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם הִנְנִ֨י פֹקֵ֧ד עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם אֶת־ רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- hā·rō·‘îm hā·rō·‘îm ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ’at·tem hă·p̄i·ṣō·ṯem ’eṯ- ṣō·nî wat·tad·di·ḥūm wə·lō p̄ə·qaḏ·tem ’ō·ṯām hin·nî p̄ō·qêḏ ‘ă·lê·ḵem ’eṯ- rō·a‘ ma·‘al·lê·ḵem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD the God of Israel says about the shepherds who tend My people You have scattered My flock and driven them away and have not attended to them Behold I will attend to you for the evil of your deeds declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR Deus de Israel, contra os pastores que apascentam o meu povo: Vós dispersastes as minhas ovelhas, e as afugentastes, e não as visitastes; eis que visitarei sobre vós a maldade das vossas ações, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י אֲקַבֵּץ֙ אֶת־ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית צֹאנִ֔י מִכֹּל֙ הָאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ הִדַּ֥חְתִּי אֹתָ֖ם שָׁ֑ם וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י אֶתְהֶ֛ן עַל־ נְוֵהֶ֖ן וּפָר֥וּ וְרָבֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ă·qab·bêṣ ’eṯ- šə·’ê·rîṯ ṣō·nî mik·kōl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer- hid·daḥ·tî ’ō·ṯām šām wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî ’eṯ·hen ‘al- nə·wê·hen ū·p̄ā·rū wə·rā·ḇū
verses.literal: Then I Myself will gather the remnant of My flock from all the lands to which I have banished them - and I will return them to their pasture where they will be fruitful and multiply
verses.literalPt: E eu mesmo recolherei o restante das minhas ovelhas, de todas as terras para onde as tiver afugentado, e as farei voltar aos seus apriscos; e frutificarão, e se multiplicarão.

verses.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֧י עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם רֹעִ֖ים וְרָע֑וּם וְלֹא־ יִֽירְא֨וּ ע֧וֹד וְלֹא־ יֵחַ֛תּוּ וְלֹ֥א יִפָּקֵ֖דוּ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·qi·mō·ṯî ‘ă·lê·hem rō·‘îm wə·rā·‘ūm wə·lō- yî·rə·’ū ‘ō·wḏ wə·lō- yê·ḥat·tū wə·lō yip·pā·qê·ḏū nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will raise up shepherds over them who will tend them and they will no longer be afraid or dismayed . . . nor will any go missing declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: E levantarei sobre elas pastores que as apascentem, e nunca mais temerão, nem se assombrarão, e nem uma delas faltará, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וַהֲקִמֹתִ֥י לְדָוִ֖ד צֶ֣מַח צַדִּ֑יק וּמָ֤לַךְ מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ וְהִשְׂכִּ֔יל וְעָשָׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh yā·mîm bā·’îm nə·’um- Yah·weh wa·hă·qi·mō·ṯî lə·ḏā·wiḏ ṣe·maḥ ṣad·dîq ū·mā·laḵ me·leḵ wə·hiś·kîl wə·‘ā·śāh miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Behold the days are coming declares the LORD when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch and He will reign wisely as King and will administer justice and righteousness in the land
verses.literalPt: Eis que vêm dias, diz o SENHOR, em que levantarei a Davi um Renovo justo; e, sendo rei, reinará e agirá sabiamente, e praticará o juízo e a justiça na terra.

verses.original: בְּיָמָיו֙ תִּוָּשַׁ֣ע יְהוּדָ֔ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִשְׁכֹּ֣ן לָבֶ֑טַח וְזֶה־ שְּׁמ֥וֹ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ יִקְרְא֖וֹ יְהוָ֥ה׀ צִדְקֵֽנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·yā·māw tiw·wā·ša‘ yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yiś·rā·’êl yiš·kōn lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ wə·zeh- šə·mōw ’ăšer- yiq·rə·’ōw Yah·weh ṣiḏ·qê·nū
verses.literal: In His days Judah will be saved and Israel will dwell securely And this is His name by which He will be called The LORD Our Righteousness
verses.literalPt: Nos seus dias Judá será salvo, e Israel habitará seguro; e este será o seu nome, com o qual Deus o chamará: O SENHOR JUSTIÇA NOSSA.

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן הִנֵּֽה־ יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹא־ יֹ֤אמְרוּ עוֹד֙ חַי־ יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nêh- yā·mîm bā·’îm nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·lō- yō·mə·rū ‘ō·wḏ ḥay- Yah·weh ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lāh ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: So behold the days are coming declares the LORD when they will no longer say As surely as the LORD lives who brought the Israelites up . . . out of the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Portanto, eis que vêm dias, diz o SENHOR, em que nunca mais dirão: Vive o SENHOR, que fez subir os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito;

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ חַי־ יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶעֱלָה֩ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יא אֶת־ זֶ֨רַע בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹנָה וּמִכֹּל֙ הָֽאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִדַּחְתִּ֖ים שָׁ֑ם וְיָשְׁב֖וּ עַל־ אַדְמָתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- ḥay- Yah·weh ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lāh wa·’ă·šer hê·ḇî ’eṯ- ze·ra‘ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh ū·mik·kōl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer hid·daḥ·tîm šām wə·yā·šə·ḇū ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯām
verses.literal: Instead they will say As surely as the LORD lives who brought and led the descendants of the house of Israel up out of the land of the north and all the other lands to which He had banished them . . . Then they will dwell once more in their own land
verses.literalPt: Mas: Vive o SENHOR, que fez subir, e que trouxe a geração da casa de Israel da terra do norte, e de todas as terras para onde os tinha arrojado; e habitarão na sua terra.

verses.original: לַנְּבִאִ֞ים נִשְׁבַּ֧ר לִבִּ֣י בְקִרְבִּ֗י רָֽחֲפוּ֙ כָּל־ עַצְמוֹתַ֔י הָיִ֙יתִי֙ כְּאִ֣ישׁ שִׁכּ֔וֹר וּכְגֶ֖בֶר עֲבָ֣רוֹ יָ֑יִן מִפְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּמִפְּנֵ֖י דִּבְרֵ֥י קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lan·nə·ḇi·’îm niš·bar lib·bî ḇə·qir·bî rā·ḥă·p̄ū kāl- ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯay hā·yî·ṯî kə·’îš šik·kō·wr ū·ḵə·ḡe·ḇer ‘ă·ḇā·rōw yā·yin mip·pə·nê Yah·weh ū·mip·pə·nê diḇ·rê qā·ḏə·šōw
verses.literal: As for the prophets My heart is broken within me and all my bones tremble I have become like a drunkard . . . like a man overcome by wine because of the LORD because of His holy words
verses.literalPt: Quanto aos profetas, já o meu coração está quebrantado dentro de mim; todos os meus ossos estremecem; sou como um homem embriagado, e como um homem vencido de vinho, por causa do SENHOR, e por causa das suas santas palavras.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מְנָֽאֲפִים֙ מָלְאָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּֽי־ מִפְּנֵ֤י אָלָה֙ אָבְלָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ יָבְשׁ֖וּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר וַתְּהִ֤י מְרֽוּצָתָם֙ רָעָ֔ה וּגְבוּרָתָ֖ם לֹא־ כֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kî mə·nā·’ă·p̄îm mā·lə·’āh hā·’ā·reṣ kî- mip·pə·nê ’ā·lāh ’ā·ḇə·lāh hā·’ā·reṣ yā·ḇə·šū nə·’ō·wṯ miḏ·bār wat·tə·hî mə·rū·ṣā·ṯām rā·‘āh ū·ḡə·ḇū·rā·ṯām lō- ḵên
verses.literal: For the land . . . is full of adulterers because of the curse the land mourns and the pastures of the wilderness have dried up their course is evil and their power is misused . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque a terra está cheia de adúlteros, e a terra chora por causa da maldição; os pastos do deserto se secam; porque a sua carreira é má, e a sua força não é reta.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ גַם־ נָבִ֥יא גַם־ כֹּהֵ֖ן חָנֵ֑פוּ גַּם־ בְּבֵיתִ֛י מָצָ֥אתִי רָעָתָ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḡam- nā·ḇî ḡam- kō·hên ḥā·nê·p̄ū gam- bə·ḇê·ṯî mā·ṣā·ṯî rā·‘ā·ṯām nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: For both prophet and priest are ungodly even in My house I have found their wickedness declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porque tanto o profeta, como o sacerdote, estão contaminados; até na minha casa achei a sua maldade, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ יִֽהְיֶ֨ה דַרְכָּ֜ם לָהֶ֗ם כַּחֲלַקְלַקּוֹת֙ בָּֽאֲפֵלָ֔ה יִדַּ֖חוּ וְנָ֣פְלוּ בָ֑הּ כִּֽי־ אָבִ֨יא עֲלֵיהֶ֥ם רָעָ֛ה שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên yih·yeh ḏar·kām lā·hem ka·ḥă·laq·laq·qō·wṯ bā·’ă·p̄ê·lāh yid·da·ḥū wə·nā·p̄ə·lū ḇāh kî- ’ā·ḇî ‘ă·lê·hem rā·‘āh šə·naṯ pə·qud·dā·ṯām nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Therefore their path . . . will become slick they will be driven away into the darkness and fall into it For I will bring disaster upon them in the year of their punishment declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Portanto o seu caminho lhes será como lugares escorregadios na escuridão; serão empurrados, e cairão nele; porque trarei sobre eles mal, no ano da sua visitação, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: וּבִנְבִיאֵ֥י שֹׁמְר֖וֹן רָאִ֣יתִי תִפְלָ֑ה הִנַּבְּא֣וּ בַבַּ֔עַל וַיַּתְע֥וּ אֶת־ עַמִּ֖י אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇin·ḇî·’ê šō·mə·rō·wn rā·’î·ṯî ṯip̄·lāh hin·nab·bə·’ū ḇab·ba·‘al way·yaṯ·‘ū ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Among the prophets of Samaria I saw an offensive thing They prophesied by Baal and led My people Israel astray
verses.literalPt: Nos profetas de Samaria bem vi loucura; profetizavam da parte de Baal, e faziam errar o meu povo Israel.

verses.original: וּבִנְבִאֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם רָאִ֣יתִי שַׁעֲרוּרָ֗ה נָא֞וֹף וְהָלֹ֤ךְ בַּשֶּׁ֙קֶר֙ וְחִזְּקוּ֙ יְדֵ֣י מְרֵעִ֔ים לְבִ֨לְתִּי־ שָׁ֔בוּ אִ֖ישׁ מֵרָֽעָת֑וֹ הָֽיוּ־ לִ֤י כֻלָּם֙ כִּסְדֹ֔ם וְיֹשְׁבֶ֖יהָ כַּעֲמֹרָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇin·ḇi·’ê yə·rū·šā·lim rā·’î·ṯî ša·‘ă·rū·rāh nā·’ō·wp̄ wə·hā·lōḵ baš·še·qer wə·ḥiz·zə·qū yə·ḏê mə·rê·‘îm lə·ḇil·tî- šā·ḇū ’îš mê·rā·‘ā·ṯōw hā·yū- lî ḵul·lām kis·ḏōm wə·yō·šə·ḇe·hā ka·‘ă·mō·rāh
verses.literal: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a horrible thing They commit adultery and walk in lies They strengthen the hands of evildoers so that no one turns his back on wickedness They are all like Sodom to Me the people of Jerusalem are like Gomorrah
verses.literalPt: Mas nos profetas de Jerusalém vejo uma coisa horrenda: cometem adultérios, e andam com falsidade, e fortalecem as mãos dos malfeitores, para que não se convertam da sua maldade; eles têm-se tornado para mim como Sodoma, e os seus moradores como Gomorra.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ עַל־ הַנְּבִאִ֔ים הִנְנִ֨י מַאֲכִ֤יל אוֹתָם֙ לַֽעֲנָ֔ה וְהִשְׁקִתִ֖ים מֵי־ רֹ֑אשׁ כִּ֗י מֵאֵת֙ נְבִיאֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם יָצְאָ֥ה חֲנֻפָּ֖ה לְכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘al- han·nə·ḇi·’îm hin·nî ma·’ă·ḵîl ’ō·w·ṯām la·‘ă·nāh wə·hiš·qi·ṯîm mê- rōš kî mê·’êṯ nə·ḇî·’ê yə·rū·šā·lim yā·ṣə·’āh ḥă·nup·pāh lə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts says concerning the prophets . . . I will feed them wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness . . . has spread throughout the land
verses.literalPt: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos acerca dos profetas: Eis que lhes darei a comer losna, e lhes farei beber águas de fel; porque dos profetas de Jerusalém saiu a contaminação sobre toda a terra.

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אַֽל־ תִּשְׁמְע֞וּ עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֤י הַנְּבִאִים֙ הַנִּבְּאִ֣ים לָכֶ֔ם מַהְבִּלִ֥ים הֵ֖מָּה אֶתְכֶ֑ם חֲז֤וֹן לִבָּם֙ יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ לֹ֖א מִפִּ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’al- tiš·mə·‘ū ‘al- diḇ·rê han·nə·ḇi·’îm han·nib·bə·’îm lā·ḵem mah·bi·lîm hêm·māh ’eṯ·ḵem ḥă·zō·wn lib·bām yə·ḏab·bê·rū lō mip·pî Yah·weh
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts says Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you They are filling you with false hopes . . . They speak visions from their own minds not from the mouth of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Não deis ouvidos às palavras dos profetas, que entre vós profetizam; fazem-vos desvanecer; falam da visão do seu coração, não da boca do SENHOR.

verses.original: אֹמְרִ֤ים אָמוֹר֙ לִֽמְנַאֲצַ֔י דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שָׁל֖וֹם יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם וְ֠כֹל הֹלֵ֞ךְ בִּשְׁרִר֤וּת לִבּוֹ֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹֽא־ תָב֥וֹא עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם רָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·mə·rîm ’ā·mō·wr lim·na·’ă·ṣay dib·ber Yah·weh šā·lō·wm yih·yeh lā·ḵem wə·ḵōl hō·lêḵ biš·ri·rūṯ lib·bōw ’ā·mə·rū lō- ṯā·ḇō·w ‘ă·lê·ḵem rā·‘āh
verses.literal: They keep saying . . . to those who despise Me The LORD says that you will have peace and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart No harm will come to you
verses.literalPt: Dizem continuamente aos que me desprezam: O SENHOR disse: Paz tereis; e a qualquer que anda segundo a dureza do seu coração, dizem: Não virá mal sobre vós.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֤י עָמַד֙ בְּס֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה וְיֵ֖רֶא וְיִשְׁמַ֣ע אֶת־ דְּבָר֑וֹ מִֽי־ הִקְשִׁ֥יב דְּבָרִי וַיִּשְׁמָֽע׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî mî ‘ā·maḏ bə·sō·wḏ Yah·weh wə·yê·re wə·yiš·ma‘ ’eṯ- də·ḇā·rōw mî- hiq·šîḇ də·ḇå̄·rī way·yiš·mā‘
verses.literal: But which of them has stood in the council of the LORD to see and hear His word Who has given heed to His word and obeyed it
verses.literalPt: Porque, quem esteve no conselho do SENHOR, e viu, e ouviu a sua palavra? Quem esteve atento à sua palavra, e ouviu?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה׀ סַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה חֵמָה֙ יָֽצְאָ֔ה וְסַ֖עַר מִתְחוֹלֵ֑ל עַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ רְשָׁעִ֖ים יָחֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh sa·‘ă·raṯ Yah·weh ḥê·māh yā·ṣə·’āh wə·sa·‘ar miṯ·ḥō·w·lêl ‘al rōš rə·šā·‘îm yā·ḥūl
verses.literal: Behold the storm of the LORD has gone out with fury a whirlwind . . . swirling down upon the heads of the wicked
verses.literalPt: Eis que saiu com indignação a tempestade do SENHOR; e uma tempestade penosa cairá cruelmente sobre a cabeça dos ímpios.

verses.original: לֹ֤א יָשׁוּב֙ אַף־ יְהוָ֔ה עַד־ עֲשֹׂת֥וֹ וְעַד־ הֲקִימ֖וֹ מְזִמּ֣וֹת לִבּ֑וֹ בְּאַֽחֲרִית֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים תִּתְבּ֥וֹנְנוּ בָ֖הּ בִּינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō yā·šūḇ ’ap̄- Yah·weh ‘aḏ- ‘ă·śō·ṯōw wə·‘aḏ- hă·qî·mōw mə·zim·mō·wṯ lib·bōw bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ hay·yā·mîm tiṯ·bō·wn·nū ḇāh bî·nāh
verses.literal: The anger of the LORD will not turn back until He has fully accomplished . . . . . . the purposes of His heart In the days to come you will understand this clearly
verses.literalPt: Não se desviará a ira do SENHOR, até que execute e cumpra os desígnios do seu coração; nos últimos dias entendereis isso claramente.

verses.original: לֹא־ שָׁלַ֥חְתִּי אֶת־ הַנְּבִאִ֖ים וְהֵ֣ם רָ֑צוּ לֹא־ דִבַּ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְהֵ֥ם נִבָּֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- šā·laḥ·tî ’eṯ- han·nə·ḇi·’îm wə·hêm rā·ṣū lō- ḏib·bar·tî ’ă·lê·hem wə·hêm nib·bā·’ū
verses.literal: I did not send these prophets yet they have run with their message I did not speak to them yet they have prophesied
verses.literalPt: Não mandei esses profetas, contudo eles foram correndo; não lhes falei, contudo eles profetizaram.

verses.original: וְאִֽם־ עָמְד֖וּ בְּסוֹדִ֑י וְיַשְׁמִ֤עוּ דְבָרַי֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י וִֽישִׁבוּם֙ מִדַּרְכָּ֣ם הָרָ֔ע וּמֵרֹ֖עַ מַֽעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ‘ā·mə·ḏū bə·sō·w·ḏî wə·yaš·mi·‘ū ḏə·ḇā·ray ’eṯ- ‘am·mî wî·ši·ḇūm mid·dar·kām hā·rā‘ ū·mê·rō·a‘ ma·‘al·lê·hem
verses.literal: But if they had stood in My council they would have proclaimed My words to My people and turned them back from their evil ways and deeds
verses.literalPt: Mas, se estivessem estado no meu conselho, então teriam feito o meu povo ouvir as minhas palavras, e o teriam feito voltar do seu mau caminho, e da maldade das suas ações.

verses.original: הַאֱלֹהֵ֧י מִקָּרֹ֛ב אָ֖נִי נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א אֱלֹהֵ֖י מֵרָחֹֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ĕ·lō·hê miq·qā·rōḇ ’ā·nî nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·lō ’ĕ·lō·hê mê·rā·ḥōq
verses.literal: Am I only a God nearby declares the LORD and not a God far away
verses.literalPt: Porventura sou eu Deus de perto, diz o SENHOR, e não também Deus de longe?

verses.original: אִם־ יִסָּתֵ֨ר אִ֧ישׁ בַּמִּסְתָּרִ֛ים וַאֲנִ֥י לֹֽא־ אֶרְאֶ֖נּוּ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה הֲל֨וֹא אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֧יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲנִ֥י מָלֵ֖א נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yis·sā·ṯêr ’îš bam·mis·tā·rîm wa·’ă·nî lō- ’er·’en·nū nə·’um- Yah·weh hă·lō·w ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·nî mā·lê nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Can a man hide in secret places where I cannot see him declares the LORD Do I not fill the heavens and the earth declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Esconder-se-ia alguém em esconderijos, de modo que eu não o veja? diz o SENHOR. Porventura não encho eu os céus e a terra? diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־ אָֽמְרוּ֙ הַנְּבִאִ֔ים הַֽנִּבְּאִ֥ים בִּשְׁמִ֛י שֶׁ֖קֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר חָלַ֖מְתִּי חָלָֽמְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·tî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ’ā·mə·rū han·nə·ḇi·’îm han·nib·bə·’îm biš·mî še·qer lê·mōr ḥā·lam·tî ḥā·lā·mə·tî
verses.literal: I have heard the sayings of the prophets who prophesy lies . . . in My name I had a dream I had a dream
verses.literalPt: Tenho ouvido o que dizem aqueles profetas, profetizando mentiras em meu nome, dizendo: Sonhei, sonhei.

verses.original: עַד־ מָתַ֗י הֲיֵ֛שׁ בְּלֵ֥ב הַנְּבִאִ֖ים נִבְּאֵ֣י הַשָּׁ֑קֶר וּנְבִיאֵ֖י תַּרְמִ֥ת לִבָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay hă·yêš bə·lêḇ han·nə·ḇi·’îm nib·bə·’ê haš·šā·qer ū·nə·ḇî·’ê tar·miṯ lib·bām
verses.literal: How long . . . will this continue in the hearts of these prophets who prophesy falsehood these prophets of the delusion of their own minds
verses.literalPt: Até quando sucederá isso no coração dos profetas que profetizam mentiras, e que só profetizam do engano do seu coração?

verses.original: הַחֹשְׁבִ֗ים לְהַשְׁכִּ֤יחַ אֶת־ עַמִּי֙ שְׁמִ֔י בַּחֲל֣וֹמֹתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְסַפְּר֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ לְרֵעֵ֑הוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁכְח֧וּ אֲבוֹתָ֛ם אֶת־ שְׁמִ֖י בַּבָּֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥō·šə·ḇîm lə·haš·kî·aḥ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî šə·mî ba·ḥă·lō·w·mō·ṯām ’ă·šer yə·sap·pə·rū ’îš lə·rê·‘ê·hū ka·’ă·šer šā·ḵə·ḥū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām ’eṯ- šə·mî bab·bā·‘al
verses.literal: They suppose the dreams that they tell one another will make My people forget My name just as their fathers forgot My name through the worship of Baal
verses.literalPt: Os quais cuidam fazer com que o meu povo se esqueça do meu nome pelos seus sonhos que cada um conta ao seu próximo, assim como seus pais se esqueceram do meu nome por causa de Baal.

verses.original: הַנָּבִ֞יא אֲשֶׁר־ אִתּ֤וֹ חֲלוֹם֙ יְסַפֵּ֣ר חֲל֔וֹם וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר דְּבָרִי֙ אִתּ֔וֹ יְדַבֵּ֥ר דְּבָרִ֖י אֱמֶ֑ת מַה־ לַתֶּ֥בֶן אֶת־ הַבָּ֖ר נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: han·nā·ḇî ’ă·šer- ’it·tōw ḥă·lō·wm yə·sap·pêr ḥă·lō·wm wa·’ă·šer də·ḇā·rî ’it·tōw yə·ḏab·bêr də·ḇā·rî ’ĕ·meṯ mah- lat·te·ḇen ’eṯ- hab·bār nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Let the prophet who has a dream retell it but let him who has My word speak it truthfully For what is straw compared to grain declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: O profeta que tem um sonho conte o sonho; e aquele que tem a minha palavra, fale a minha palavra com verdade. Que tem a palha com o trigo? diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: הֲל֨וֹא כֹ֧ה דְבָרִ֛י כָּאֵ֖שׁ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וּכְפַטִּ֖ישׁ יְפֹ֥צֵֽץ סָֽלַע׃ס
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ḵōh ḏə·ḇā·rî kā·’êš nə·’um- Yah·weh ū·ḵə·p̄aṭ·ṭîš yə·p̄ō·ṣêṣ sā·la‘
verses.literal: Is not . . . My word like fire declares the LORD and like a hammer that smashes a rock
verses.literalPt: Porventura a minha palavra não é como o fogo, diz o SENHOR, e como um martelo que esmiúça a pedra?

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן הִנְנִ֥י עַל־ הַנְּבִאִ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה מְגַנְּבֵ֣י דְבָרַ֔י אִ֖ישׁ מֵאֵ֥ת רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî ‘al- han·nə·ḇi·’îm nə·’um- Yah·weh mə·ḡan·nə·ḇê ḏə·ḇā·ray ’îš mê·’êṯ rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: Therefore behold declares the LORD I am against the prophets who steal from one . . . another words they attribute to Me
verses.literalPt: Portanto, eis que eu sou contra os profetas, diz o SENHOR, que furtam as minhas palavras, cada um ao seu próximo.

verses.original: הִנְנִ֥י עַל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה הַלֹּקְחִ֣ים לְשׁוֹנָ֔ם וַֽיִּנְאֲמ֖וּ נְאֻֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî ‘al- han·nə·ḇî·’im nə·’um- Yah·weh hal·lō·qə·ḥîm lə·šō·w·nām way·yin·’ă·mū nə·’um
verses.literal: Yes declares the LORD I am against the prophets who wag their own tongues and proclaim The LORD declares it
verses.literalPt: Eis que eu sou contra os profetas, diz o SENHOR, que usam de sua própria linguagem, e dizem: Ele disse.

verses.original: הִ֠נְנִי עַֽל־ נִבְּאֵ֞י חֲלֹמ֥וֹת שֶׁ֙קֶר֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וַֽיְסַפְּרוּם֙ וַיַּתְע֣וּ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י בְּשִׁקְרֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְפַחֲזוּתָ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֨י לֹֽא־ שְׁלַחְתִּ֜ים וְלֹ֣א צִוִּיתִ֗ים וְהוֹעֵ֛יל לֹֽא־ יוֹעִ֥ילוּ לָֽעָם־ הַזֶּ֖ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî ‘al- nib·bə·’ê ḥă·lō·mō·wṯ še·qer nə·’um- Yah·weh way·sap·pə·rūm way·yaṯ·‘ū ’eṯ- ‘am·mî bə·šiq·rê·hem ū·ḇə·p̄a·ḥă·zū·ṯām wə·’ā·nō·ḵî lō- šə·laḥ·tîm wə·lō ṣiw·wî·ṯîm wə·hō·w·‘êl lō- yō·w·‘î·lū lā·‘ām- haz·zeh nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Indeed declares the LORD I am against those who prophesy false dreams and retell them to lead My people astray with their reckless lies It was not I who sent them or commanded them and they are of no benefit . . . at all to these people declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Eis que eu sou contra os que profetizam sonhos mentirosos, diz o SENHOR, e os contam, e fazem errar o meu povo com as suas mentiras e com as suas leviandades; pois eu não os enviei, nem lhes dei ordem; e não trouxeram proveito algum a este povo, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְכִי־ יִשְׁאָלְךָ֩ הָעָ֨ם הַזֶּ֜ה אֽוֹ־ הַנָּבִ֤יא אֽוֹ־ כֹהֵן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מַה־ מַשָּׂ֖א יְהוָ֑ה וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־ מַה־ מַשָּׂ֔א וְנָטַשְׁתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yiš·’ā·lə·ḵā hā·‘ām haz·zeh ’ōw- han·nā·ḇî ’ōw- ḵō·hên lê·mōr mah- maś·śā Yah·weh wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- mah- maś·śā wə·nā·ṭaš·tî ’eṯ·ḵem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now when this people or a prophet or priest asks you What is the burden of the LORD . . . you are to say to them What burden I will forsake you declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Quando, pois, te perguntar este povo, ou qualquer profeta, ou sacerdote, dizendo: Qual é o peso do SENHOR? Então lhe dirás: Este é o peso: Que vos deixarei, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְהַנָּבִ֤יא וְהַכֹּהֵן֙ וְהָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאמַ֖ר מַשָּׂ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּפָקַדְתִּ֛י עַל־ הָאִ֥ישׁ הַה֖וּא וְעַל־ בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nā·ḇî wə·hak·kō·hên wə·hā·‘ām ’ă·šer yō·mar maś·śā Yah·weh ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al- hā·’îš ha·hū wə·‘al- bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: As for the prophet or priest or anyone who claims This is the burden of the LORD I will punish . . . that . . . man and his household
verses.literalPt: E, quanto ao profeta, e ao sacerdote, e ao povo, que disser: Peso do SENHOR, eu castigarei o tal homem e a sua casa.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֛וּ אִ֥ישׁ עַל־ רֵעֵ֖הוּ וְאִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ אָחִ֑יו מֶה־ עָנָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה וּמַה־ דִּבֶּ֖ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ṯō·mə·rū ’îš ‘al- rê·‘ê·hū wə·’îš ’el- ’ā·ḥîw meh- ‘ā·nāh Yah·weh ū·mah- dib·ber Yah·weh
verses.literal: This is what each man is to say to his friend . . . and to his brother What has the LORD answered or ‘What has the LORD spoken
verses.literalPt: Assim direis, cada um ao seu próximo, e cada um ao seu irmão: Que respondeu o SENHOR? e que falou o SENHOR?

verses.original: וּמַשָּׂ֥א יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א תִזְכְּרוּ־ ע֑וֹד כִּ֣י הַמַּשָּׂ֗א יִֽהְיֶה֙ לְאִ֣ישׁ דְּבָר֔וֹ וַהֲפַכְתֶּ֗ם אֶת־ דִּבְרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חַיִּ֔ים יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·maś·śā Yah·weh lō ṯiz·kə·rū- ‘ō·wḏ kî ham·maś·śā yih·yeh lə·’îš də·ḇā·rōw wa·hă·p̄aḵ·tem ’eṯ- diḇ·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥay·yîm Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: But refer no more to the burden of the LORD for each man’s word becomes the burden so that you pervert the words of the living God the LORD of Hosts our God
verses.literalPt: Mas nunca mais vos lembrareis do peso do SENHOR; porque a cada um lhe servirá de peso a sua própria palavra; pois torceis as palavras do Deus vivo, do SENHOR dos Exércitos, o nosso Deus.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה תֹאמַ֖ר אֶל־ הַנָּבִ֑יא מֶה־ עָנָ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה וּמַה־ דִּבֶּ֖ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ṯō·mar ’el- han·nā·ḇî meh- ‘ā·nāḵ Yah·weh ū·mah- dib·ber Yah·weh
verses.literal: Thus you are to say to the prophet What has the LORD answered you and ‘What has the LORD spoken
verses.literalPt: Assim dirás ao profeta: Que te respondeu o SENHOR, e que falou o SENHOR?

verses.original: וְאִם־ מַשָּׂ֣א יְהוָה֮ תֹּאמֵרוּ֒ לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה יַ֧עַן אֲמָרְכֶ֛ם אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה מַשָּׂ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח אֲלֵיכֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תֹאמְר֖וּ מַשָּׂ֥א יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- maś·śā Yah·weh tō·mê·rū lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ya·‘an ’ă·mā·rə·ḵem ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh maś·śā Yah·weh wā·’eš·laḥ ’ă·lê·ḵem lê·mōr lō ṯō·mə·rū maś·śā Yah·weh
verses.literal: But if you claim This is the burden of the LORD then this is what the LORD says Because you have said - . . . This is the burden of the LORD and I specifically told . . . . . . you not to make this claim
verses.literalPt: Mas, porque dizeis: Peso do SENHOR; assim o diz o SENHOR: Porque dizeis esta palavra: Peso do SENHOR, havendo-vos ordenado, dizendo: Não direis: Peso do SENHOR;

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן הִנְנִ֔י וְנָשִׁ֥יתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם נָשֹׁ֑א וְנָטַשְׁתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֗ם וְאֶת־ הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תִּי לָכֶ֛ם וְלַאֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם מֵעַ֥ל פָּנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî wə·nā·šî·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem nā·šō wə·nā·ṭaš·tî ’eṯ·ḵem wə·’eṯ- hā·‘îr ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem wə·la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem mê·‘al pā·nāy
verses.literal: therefore I will surely forget you and will cast you out of My presence both you and the city that I gave to you and your fathers
verses.literalPt: Por isso, eis que também eu me esquecerei totalmente de vós, e tirarei da minha presença, a vós e a cidade que vos dei a vós e a vossos pais;

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם חֶרְפַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וּכְלִמּ֣וּת עוֹלָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכֵֽחַ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ‘ă·lê·ḵem ḥer·paṯ ‘ō·w·lām ū·ḵə·lim·mūṯ ‘ō·w·lām ’ă·šer lō ṯiš·šā·ḵê·aḥ
verses.literal: And I will bring upon you everlasting shame and perpetual humiliation that will never be forgotten
verses.literalPt: E porei sobre vós perpétuo opróbrio, e eterna vergonha, que não será esquecida.
